description: This file defines the TransactionInfo class used for managing transaction state, including participant access counts, exception handling, and transaction metadata within the Orleans transaction system.

classes.name: TransactionInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates the state and metadata of a transaction, including participant access counts, transaction ID, timestamps, and exception info.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes participant dictionary and joined queue.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing transaction ID, timestamps, and read-only flag.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Copy constructor used when transferring transaction info to another context.

methods.name: Fork
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the transaction info with increased pending calls.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Enqueues another TransactionInfo instance to this transaction's joined list.

methods.name: MustAbort
methods.description: Determines if the transaction must abort based on recorded exceptions or pending calls.

methods.name: RecordException
methods.description: Records an exception as an abort reason, serializing it for later retrieval.

methods.name: ReconcilePending
methods.description: Merges all joined transactions into this one, updating timestamp, exceptions, and participant counts.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Merges another TransactionInfo into this one, combining participant access counts and updating metadata.

methods.name: RecordRead
methods.description: Records a read access by a participant, updating timestamp if necessary.

methods.name: RecordWrite
methods.description: Records a write access by a participant, updating timestamp if necessary.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transaction info.
